# Aaradhya Enviro

> Aaradhya Enviro is an environmental consultancy and turnkey pollution control company in Waluj MIDC, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad), Maharashtra, India. Founded in 2018, it has served 500+ clients and offers 17 services: MPCB consents (CTE/CTO), Environmental Clearance, ETP/STP and ZLD plants, air pollution control, environmental testing and monitoring, hazardous waste and plastic EPR compliance, operation & maintenance and compliance training.

- Head office: 10, Wadgaon Kolhati, MIDC Waluj Area, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra 431136

- Languages: English, Hindi, Marathi

## Compliance & Consultancy
- [MPCB Consent & Legal Compliance](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/services/legal-compliances): Every industry or project in Maharashtra that discharges effluent, emits air pollutants or generates hazardous waste needs MPCB consent: Consent to Establish (CTE) before construction and Consent to Operate (CTO) before production, renewed before expiry. Aaradhya Enviro prepares, files and follows up these applications and tracks consent conditions for units across Maharashtra.
- [Environmental Clearance (EC)](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/services/environmental-clearances): Projects listed in the EIA Notification, 2006 — large construction projects, specified industries, mining and infrastructure — need prior Environmental Clearance (EC) from SEIAA Maharashtra (Category B) or MoEFCC (Category A). The process covers Form 1, Terms of Reference, EIA study, public hearing where required, appraisal and six-monthly compliance reports after approval.
- [Environmental Audit & Reporting](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/services/audit-reporting): Consent-holding units in Maharashtra must file an Environmental Statement (Form V) every year by 30 September, and hazardous waste generators must file an annual return by 30 June. Aaradhya Enviro prepares these filings from your actual operating data and carries out independent compliance audits that find gaps before an MPCB inspection does.
- [CGWA NOC & Bio-Medical Waste Authorisation](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/services/cgwa-biomedical-noc): Industries and projects drawing groundwater generally need a groundwater extraction NOC under the CGWA guidelines, with flow meters, piezometers and water audits. Every healthcare facility that generates bio-medical waste — hospitals, clinics, labs — needs MPCB authorisation under the Bio-Medical Waste Management Rules, 2016, plus segregation, a CBWTF tie-up and an annual report.

## Turnkey Projects
- [ETP & STP Design and Installation](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/services/etp-stp-installation): An ETP treats industrial process wastewater; an STP treats domestic sewage from toilets, kitchens and washrooms. A reliable plant is designed from your measured flow and wastewater analysis, not a standard template. Aaradhya Enviro designs, supplies, installs and commissions ETPs and STPs to meet MPCB consent limits, and trains your operators at handover.
- [ZLD & RO Systems](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/services/zld-ro-systems): Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) means no liquid effluent leaves the premises: wastewater is treated and recovered for reuse, and the remaining salts are dried for authorised disposal. A typical ZLD system combines pre-treatment, ultrafiltration, high-recovery RO and an evaporator with a dryer. It is often a condition in consents of highly polluting units.
- [Air Pollution Control Systems](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/services/air-pollution-control): Boilers, furnaces, DG sets and process vents must meet the emission limits in your MPCB consent and have proper stacks with sampling ports. The right control device depends on the pollutant: cyclones and bag filters for dust, wet or venturi scrubbers for acid gases and fumes, packed-bed scrubbers for odour and soluble gases.
- [Plant Up-gradation & Retrofit](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/services/plant-upgradation): An existing ETP or STP that fails consent limits can often be fixed without rebuilding. A performance audit compares actual flow and load with the design; common upgrades include MBBR conversion for extra capacity, efficient blowers and fine-bubble diffusers, tertiary filtration, better sludge handling and automation, carried out in phases to keep the plant running.

## Testing & Monitoring
- [Air, Water & Soil Testing](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/services/environmental-testing): MPCB consents require regular monitoring of treated effluent, stack emissions, ambient air and often noise and groundwater, at the frequency written in the consent. Aaradhya Enviro plans the monitoring schedule, coordinates sampling and analysis through accredited laboratories and checks every result against your consent limits, with corrective advice when a parameter fails.
- [Noise Level Monitoring](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/services/noise-monitoring): Under the Noise Pollution (Regulation and Control) Rules, 2000, ambient noise in industrial areas must stay within 75 dB(A) by day (6 a.m.–10 p.m.) and 70 dB(A) at night. Many consents require periodic boundary noise monitoring. Practical controls include acoustic enclosures, silencers, vibration isolation, barriers and maintenance of noisy equipment.
- [Online Monitoring Systems (OCEMS)](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/services/online-monitoring-systems): Highly polluting industries and units directed by CPCB or MPCB must install online continuous emission (CEMS) and effluent (CEQMS) monitoring systems that transmit live data to the CPCB and MPCB servers. Correct analyser selection, installation, calibration and data connectivity are essential to avoid data gaps and false exceedance alerts.
- [Treatability Studies](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/services/treatability-studies): A treatability study tests your actual wastewater in the laboratory or at pilot scale — jar tests, biodegradability, oxidation and biological trials — to find which treatment process works, the chemical doses needed and the outlet quality achievable. It is the safest way to design a new ETP, ZLD system or upgrade before investing.

## Management & Training
- [Hazardous Waste Management](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/services/hazardous-waste-management): ETP sludge, used oil, spent solvents and many process residues are hazardous waste under the Hazardous and Other Wastes Rules, 2016. Generators need MPCB authorisation, safe storage for a limited period, manifests for every consignment to an authorised facility, and an annual return filed by 30 June.
- [Plastic EPR Compliance](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/services/plastic-epr-compliance): Producers, importers and brand owners that introduce plastic packaging in India must register on the CPCB centralised EPR portal, meet category-wise collection and recycling targets through EPR certificates from registered processors, and file annual returns. Missing targets can attract environmental compensation under the EPR guidelines.
- [Operation & Maintenance (O&M)](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/services/operation-maintenance): Treatment plants stay compliant only with daily operation: correct aeration, sludge wasting, chemical dosing, routine testing, logbooks and preventive maintenance. Aaradhya Enviro provides trained operators or supervision for ETP, STP, RO and ZLD plants, with daily records, performance reports and engineer support when problems appear.
- [Compliance Training](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/services/compliance-training): Most compliance failures come from people not knowing what is required, not from equipment. Practical training for managers, EHS teams and operators — consent conditions, ETP/STP operation, hazardous waste handling, record keeping and audit readiness — prevents them. Aaradhya Enviro delivers on-site training in English, Hindi or Marathi.
- [Nucleonic Gauge & Radioactive Source Compliance](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/services/nucleonic-material): Industrial nucleonic gauges contain sealed radioactive sources regulated by the Atomic Energy Regulatory Board (AERB). They must be licensed and documented, and disused sources must never be scrapped: they are returned to the supplier or transferred to an AERB-authorised agency. Aaradhya Enviro handles the documentation and coordination; authorised agencies handle the sources.

## Guides
- [MPCB Show-Cause or Closure Notice? What to Do First](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/mpcb-show-cause-notice-closure-direction-what-to-do): Received an MPCB show-cause notice or closure direction? A practical 7-day plan: root cause, corrective action, evidence and a reply that works.
- [MIDC Environmental Compliance Checklist: Sambhajinagar](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/environmental-compliance-checklist-midc-chhatrapati-sambhajinagar): Step-by-step environmental approvals for new units in Waluj, Shendra, Chikalthana and AURIC: category check, CTE, treatment plant, CTO and yearly returns.
- [ETP Cost in India: What Really Decides the Price](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/etp-cost-in-india-price-factors): What decides the cost of an effluent treatment plant: flow, pollution load, TDS, outlet norms and technology, plus the running costs buyers often forget.
- [STP for Housing Societies in Maharashtra: Complete Guide](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/stp-for-housing-societies-maharashtra): STP guide for housing societies: why it is required, how to size it in KLD, MBBR vs SBR vs MBR, treated water reuse, running costs and common problems.
- [MPCB Red, Orange, Green & White Categories Explained](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/mpcb-red-orange-green-white-category-guide): How MPCB classifies industries as Red, Orange, Green or White, how to find your category, why it matters for consent, and common classification mistakes.
- [Comprehensive Guide to ETP & STP Operations](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/comprehensive-guide-to-etp-and-stp-operations): A deep dive into the technical maintenance, biological parameters, and regulatory compliance for Effluent and Sewage Treatment Plants.
- [Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD): The Future of Industry](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/zero-liquid-discharge-the-future-of-industry): An advanced technical overview of ZLD mechanics, exploring RO membranes, evaporators, and crystallizers.
- [Mastering MPCB Consent Procedures (CTE/CTO)](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/mastering-mpcb-consent-procedures): A definitive guide to obtaining and maintaining Consent to Establish and Consent to Operate in Maharashtra.
- [Air Pollution Control: Scrubbers vs. Baghouse Filters](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/air-pollution-control-scrubbers-vs-baghouse-filters): A technical comparative analysis of wet and dry air pollution control devices for industrial chimneys.
- [A Guide to flawless Environmental Audits](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/a-guide-to-flawless-environmental-audits): Detailed methodologies and checklists to guarantee zero non-compliances during regulatory inspections.
- [Decoding Plastic Waste Management (EPR)](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/decoding-plastic-waste-management): Extended Producer Responsibility explained: Targets, portals, certificates, and heavy environmental compensations.
- [Bio-Medical Waste Segregation Protocols](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/bio-medical-waste-segregation-protocols): Life-saving technical protocols for hospitals on color-coding, barcoding, and safe disposal of BMW.
- [Groundwater Extraction & CGWA Compliance](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/groundwater-extraction-and-cgwa-compliance): Understanding telemetry, water audits, and the stringent process for obtaining a CGWA NOC.
- [Industrial Noise Pollution & Abatement](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/industrial-noise-pollution-and-abatement): Technical strategies for mapping noise contours and implementing acoustic enclosures for heavy machinery.
- [Mastering the Hazardous Waste Manifest (Form 10)](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/mastering-the-hazardous-waste-manifest): A deep technical dive into cradle-to-grave tracking of hazardous waste using the 7-color manifest system.
- [The Science of Treatability Studies](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/the-science-of-treatability-studies): Why lab-scale testing of chemical dosing and biological degradation is the only way to design a functional ETP.
- [Online Continuous Emission Monitoring (OCEMS)](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/online-continuous-emission-monitoring): Inside the real-time telemetry systems that stream compliance data directly to CPCB servers 24/7.
- [Industrial Rainwater Harvesting (RWH)](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/industrial-rainwater-harvesting): Engineering massive recharge structures to offset extraction and build true water independence.
- [Preventing Reverse Osmosis (RO) Membrane Failure](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/preventing-reverse-osmosis-membrane-failure): Technical deep-dive into combating organic fouling, inorganic scaling, and catastrophic membrane oxidation.
- [Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) Dynamics](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/environmental-impact-assessment-dynamics): A deep analysis of the 4-stage EIA process required to obtain supreme Environmental Clearance (EC) in India.
- [Retrofitting & Upgrading Aging ETPs](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/retrofitting-and-upgrading-aging-etps): Strategic engineering techniques to double the capacity and efficiency of an old ETP without buying new land.
- [The Strategic Value of Form V (Environmental Statement)](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/the-strategic-value-of-form-v): Why Form V is far more than a clerical task, acting as the ultimate balance sheet of your environmental footprint.
- [Stack Emission Monitoring: The Isokinetic Rule](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/stack-emission-monitoring-the-isokinetic-rule): The critical science behind accurate stack sampling, porthole placement, and avoiding legal disputes over invalid data.
- [Hazardous Waste Storage: Design & Safety Protocols](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/hazardous-waste-storage-design-and-safety-protocols): Engineering a legally compliant, leak-proof, and fire-safe hazardous waste storage facility inside your plant.
- [Circular Economy: The Future of Green Manufacturing](https://aaradhyaenviro.com/blog/circular-economy-the-future-of-green-manufacturing): Transitioning from compliance to profitability through co-processing, ESG metrics, and resource recovery.
